column1: # The corruption rows of work package S2.5: every damaged container of two corpora opened and used through the public API by analysis/bench/corpus_s24 (the runner of S2.4, one process per file and mode, Checked and Trusted, watchdog 25 s) built against the S1 head 56456a72 (base) and this package (new, 9109af24). "S24" = the 1,500 files of CorruptionCorpusS24Tests (master seed 20261124, as at S2.4); "S25" = the 2,100 files of CorruptionCorpusS25Tests (master seed 20261125): A_* = 1,500 cases of the differential harness over containers that have PSI in three cases out of four and RMQ in three out of four, P_* = 600 damages of the two navigation sections (PSI: byte flip, extreme words, two entries exchanged, rotated by one rank; RMQ: byte flip, extreme words, levels cleared, one field of the table entry changed; all sealed). Columns: set, file, mode, base, new.
